# PC*MILER Web Services: Route Reports

- **Product:** PC*MILER Web Services: Route Reports (Trimble Maps family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** API key (authToken query parameter or Authorization header). Declared security schemes: authHeaderAuth, authTokenAuth.
- **Access:** PC*MILER Web Services licence.
- **To call it you would need:** a PC*MILER Web Services API key for pcmiler.alk.com.
- **Documented servers:** `https://pcmiler.alk.com/apis/rest/v1.0/Service.svc`, `https://pcmiler.az.alk.com/apis/rest/v1.0/Service.svc`.
- **Definition:** [trimble-maps/route-reports](https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/api/route-reports.json) (PC*Miler Route Reports API, version 1.0.0). Documentation: https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/routing/route-reports/get-route-reports/, https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/routing/route-reports/overview/, https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/routing/route-reports/post-route-reports/.
